$comment: Declared non-REACHABLE states for published apt.*/rec.* operations. REACHABLE is never declared here: it is DERIVED by apps/web/tests/p1-28-qa.test.ts, which mocks the transport, runs every real adapter body and reads back the path actually requested. This file records only what that derivation cannot justify on its own, and scripts/ci/check-p1-28-adapter-reachability.mjs refuses any entry that does not satisfy every condition in its docblock. Adding an entry here is not a way to make a red gate green; it is a way to owe something in public.

rec.reception-capture-override.ownerDecision: FE-017: media is captured, registered as an immutable version, and BOUND to the requirement it satisfies.
rec.reception-capture-override.reason: Records an attributable waiver of a required capture, gated by rec.reception.evidence.override. The refusal workflow screen is what offers it, and that screen is handwritten Frontend. It is published and mirrored by this Backend remediation, which runs under p1-18-read-surface and is forbidden to write the adapter its mirror row then obliges. Widening that profile would let Frontend ride inside a Backend change reviewed by nobody, so the transition is named instead. This entry is deleted by the same change that adds the adapter and its production consumer on feature/p1-28-owner-decisions-frontend, at which point QA-001 derives REACHABLE; until then P1-28-FE-017 cannot be recorded PASS, and no 35/35 claim is possible.
